headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points on inflation worries, but indices marked a third straight week of gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment during the last trading session on Friday
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) showed strong confidence, investing ₹84,290 crore in the first half of November
A global rotation trade away from AI stocks has supported the recent comeback in Indian equities
Strong weekly performance in PSU banks and smallcap stocks helped indices maintain a three-week winning streak
whatHappening: Mahanagar Gas implemented its sixth CNG price hike since May, raising rates by ₹1.5/kg in Mumbai
Escorts Kubota announced plans for a new 60,000-capacity tractor plant in Uttar Pradesh
Thomas Cook India expects to complete the demerger of its resorts business by October 2027
Punjab National Bank targets ₹200 crore quarterly profit each from credit card and cash management verticals
summary: The Indian market ended its last session lower as inflation concerns weighed on sentiment, though indices secured a third consecutive weekly gain. Significant FPI inflows of ₹84,290 crore and a global rotation trade provided underlying support. Key corporate news included expansion plans from Escorts Kubota and a business demerger at Thomas Cook India.
